inputs.goal: build awareness for a new collection
inputs.visual_style: retro pink scrapbook poster, y2k, glitter stickers

audience_facts: Source: 1962 YouTube comments on Khaadi, Gul Ahmed and Sana Safinaz video ads.
Predicted sentiment: 63% positive, 35% neutral, 2% negative (negative comments are under-detected).
42% of comments mention the song or music.
1% mention price, 0% quality, 1% delivery or availability.
17% of comments contain a question or request.
guidance: Viewers talk a lot about music in video ads, so choose the music mood on purpose. Do not claim the product is for music lovers.
Price is rarely discussed, so do not lead with price; evidence for price messaging is weak.
Few comments discuss the clothes, so show the product clearly; evidence on design preferences is thin.

brief.headline: Shifi ki nayi pink vibe!
brief.caption: Retro vibes aur y2k style! Shifi ki yeh nayi pink graphic tee bohat hi cool aur stylish hai. Is naye collection ke saath apna swag dikhao.
brief.call_to_action: Order ke liye Instagram DM karein.
brief.image_prompt: A model wearing a pink graphic tee, product clearly visible, simple background, retro pink scrapbook poster style, y2k aesthetic, decorated with glitter stickers, no text, no logos.
brief.why: Based on 1,962 YouTube comments on Khaadi, Gul Ahmed and Sana Safinaz video ads (not this brand's own audience): 42% mention the music, so the music mood is a deliberate choice. Only 1% mention price, so the ad does not lead with price (the evidence either way is weak). Only 7% discuss the clothes, so the product is shown clearly.
